unit: McCormack Graduate School of Policy & Global Studies

labs.lab_name: McCormack Graduate School of Policy & Global Studies
labs.research_summary: A UMass Boston policy school that began in 1983 as an applied policy research institute and now runs seven research centers and institutes plus graduate programs.
labs.join_notes: The only jobs page the site links is the university-wide Human Resources home page, which has a Job Seekers section and lists graduate and undergraduate student employment; it names no openings or contact for this unit.
labs.notes: No dean or head is named on the pages read, and no people roster or general contact email was found, so lead and member count are null. The school is a school, not a single research center; its centers are listed as separate entries. The Massachusetts Office of Public Collaboration and the Sustainable Solutions Lab appear on the page but are separate targets and are not repeated here.
